Video URL will appear here after generation.
Copy the URL and paste in browser to download.

🎬 KLING TEXT-TO-VIDEO WORKFLOW (SIMPLE)

📝 HOW TO USE:
1. Edit the PROMPT in the Kling node - describe your desired video
2. Set DURATION: 5 or 10 seconds
3. Set ASPECT RATIO: 16:9 (landscape), 9:16 (portrait), or 1:1 (square)
4. Click 'Queue Prompt' to generate
5. Wait ~5 minutes for generation
6. Copy video URL from ShowText node
7. Paste URL in browser to download video

💰 COST: ~$0.05-0.10 per 5 second video (Standard tier)

💡 PROMPT TIPS:
- Describe action, camera movement, style
- Add lighting/atmosphere details
- Keep prompts clear and specific
- Examples: 'slow zoom in', 'camera pans left', 'cinematic lighting'

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Make sure FAL_KEY environment variable is set!
